Casa De Monte

Villa in Ko Kaeo
HomeSaleCasa De Monte

Project overview

Villa community in Ko Kaeo with a greenery theme and classic European elegance. Facilities include a clubhouse and children's play park, with a gated entrance.

Five house types are offered: Aurellia (A2), Sylvia (S), Silvora (S2), Montara (M) and Lavera (L). Aurellia has a land plot of about 280-584 sqm.

Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.

Casa De Monte: key facts

  • Casa De Monte is a villas in Ko Kaeo, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).
  • Units: 3–4 bedrooms, 267–424 sqm.
  • Construction status: pre-sale; completion listed as Jul 2029.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿11,779,000.
  • Nearest beach: Kalim Beach (8.7 km, straight line).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Kalim Beach (8.7 km, straight line); Bangkok Hospital Phuket (5.1 km, straight line); Mission Hospital Phuket (5.5 km, straight line); Tesco Lotus (3.7 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Rhom Bho Property in our catalogue: Darayana Kamala, The Title Cocoon, The Title Adora Rawai, Biancana, Coralina Kamala, The Title Fizz.
